# High Court Clerk CPT

> Practice platform for the Computer Proficiency Test (C.P.T.), the qualifying
> practical stage of the Punjab & Haryana High Court / S.S.S.C. Clerk recruitment.
> Two papers: English typing (pass at 30 W.P.M.) and an MS Excel spreadsheet
> practical (pass at 4 of 10). First mock free; ₹99 gives 45 days of full access
> with no auto-renewal.

## Key facts
- Typing score = (words typed − mistakes) ÷ minutes. This is the S.S.S.C. rule,
  not conventional gross or net WPM.
- Excel: 5 gradeable parts × 2 marks = 10, pass at 4. Excel 2007 compatible.
- Both papers are qualifying; marks do not count toward the final merit list.
- Practice material is built from the official S.S.S.C. C.P.T. criteria. It is
  not real exam material.

## Pages
- /: overview of both papers and the price
- /the-exam: what the C.P.T. is, hall rules, dates
- /syllabus: skills each paper tests
- /scoring: the two scoring formulas (single source)
- /rank: public leaderboard (no account needed)
- /pricing: ₹99 for 45 days, refund rule
- /contact: contact and policies
